items.sentence: Markedly raised ESR (far above the laboratory's upper limit)
items.note: The 'over 100 mm/h' figure appears in StatPearls (extremely high ESR, over 100, often serious disease) and a review, but no NICE, NHS or British Society for Rheumatology page that was retrieved gives a figure, so the number is replaced with words. Cause list in the meaning cell (unchanged) is supported by StatPearls (GCA, malignancy, infection) and NICE NG12 (myeloma).
